name: pack_topk_ids
description: Packs each routing pair into one int32: out=(topk_ids<<16)|(bf16_bits(topk_weights)&0xFFFF). topk_ids is int32 and topk_weights is float32 with the same shape; the low 16 bits are the round-to-nearest-even bfloat16 bit pattern, not a fixed-point rescale. Returns a new int32 tensor with the input shape. Current tests exercise shapes up to [4096,2] and [512,8]; inputs are read-only.
